message:
Lena, Farah, sunny day balances with margin for the device, where Photovoltaic (PV) means solar panels.
Holding plus warm batch uses two-thirds of panel output. Numbers are 3.60 kWh holding from daily electric kWh from 150 W continuous (E52) plus 2.00 kWh batch from daily batch electric for 200 kg (E55) totalling 5.60 kWh, against 8.10 kWh from daily PV yield from 2.4 kWp (E54), fraction 0.691 from fraction of PV yield used (E56), sane against half household day.
Manager, cloudy cover is one holding day plus night with no-batch rule, where Lithium Iron Phosphate (LiFePO4) means battery chemistry.
Store stays cold by adding no warm produce until sun returns. Numbers are 2.10 kWh per 14 h night from night energy at 150 W (E57), fraction 0.410 of 5.12 kWh battery from night fraction of battery (E58) and EG4 battery datasheet (E9), giving 1.42 days holding-only from autonomy days holding only (E66), sane against battery riding one cloudy day.
Kofi, panel rack stays separate so its wind never loads cold box, where Direct Current (DC) means one-direction electricity.
Side wind pushes like three people while loaded store weighs like small car. Numbers are 540 Pa from wind pressure at 30 m per s gust (E64) giving 2.86 kN from wind force on side wall (E65), against about 16.7 kN weight, and peak chiller 8.33 A from peak DC current in amps (E62) fixes copper with 15 A fuse. Ready, because sunny margin, night reserve, cloudy rule and wiring close.
